name: Caprese-Style Spinach Salad with Grilled Apricots, Tempeh & Mozzarella

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Slice tempeh crosswise into ½-inch thick pieces and place in a large bowl. Add soy sauce, vinegar, and Italian seasoning. Gently stir to coat and set aside to marinate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (227g ) pkgs tempeh
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 tbsp Italian seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
9 apricots
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small pkg fresh basil
3 (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the pan heats up, halve apricots lengthwise (around the pit); twist halves to separate, then remove and discard pits. Season the cut-side with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the grill pan is hot, coat with oil. Working in batches, add apricot halves, cut-side down, and grill until charred and soft, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from heat and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, peel, halve, and slice onion crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in another large bowl.
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the onion along with oil, vinegar, Dijon, maple syrup, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp balsamic vinegar
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp pure maple syrup
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches, add tempeh in a single layer (leaving any excess marinade in the bowl) and cook, flipping once, until browned and warmed through, 4-5 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the tempeh is cooking, halve grape tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the dressing.
Pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons. Add to the bowl.
Cut or tear mozzarella into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 ½ (227 g) pkgs fresh mozzarella cheese

instructions.primary_message: When the apricots are cool enough to handle, thinly slice. Add to the bowl, along with spinach, and toss to combine the salad.
To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls and top with seared tempeh. Enjoy!
